title: The Neural Forcing for Three-Dimensional Incompressible Navier-Stokes finite time blowup
abstract: arXiv:2609.23934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a two-part neural framework for forced three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes flow. Part~I develops the computational forcing system. A physics-informed neural model generates structured external-force trajectories, candidates are optimized through differentiable PDE rollouts or PPO-Clip, and selected forcings are frozen and checked by independent fixed-force replay. Part~II provides the mathematical certification layer. It separates neural candidate discovery from continuum analysis, derives integrated reciprocal-vorticity criteria that imply Riccati-type growth and finite-time loss of smooth continuation, develops a validated computational-to-continuum transfer strategy, and establishes a conditional positive-probability closure for a nondegenerate neural output law. The proof is complete at the continuum level.

translated_title: 面向三维不可压Navier-Stokes方程有限时间爆破的神经强迫方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个用于受迫三维不可压Navier-Stokes流动的两部分神经框架。第一部分构建计算强迫系统：物理信息神经模型生成结构化的外力轨迹，候选方案通过可微PDE滚动或PPO-Clip进行优化，选定的强迫被冻结并通过独立的固定强迫重放加以检验。第二部分提供数学认证层：该层将神经候选发现与连续介质分析相分离，推导出积分倒涡量判据，该判据隐含Riccati型增长以及有限时间内光滑延拓的丧失，发展了经过验证的计算到连续介质的传递策略，并为非退化的神经输出律建立了条件正概率闭合。证明在连续介质层面是完备的。
tldr: 该论文提出一个两部分神经框架，利用物理信息神经网络生成并优化外力候选，再通过积分倒涡量判据等数学认证层，在连续介质层面完备地证明了受迫三维不可压Navier-Stokes方程在神经发现的强迫下可发生有限时间爆破。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-part neural framework that uses physics-informed neural networks to generate and optimize external forcing candidates, and certifies finite-time blowup of forced 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes via integrated reciprocal-vorticity criteria with a complete continuum-level proof.
